name: Pink Lemon Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Pink Lemon opens with a sweet raspberry and lemon aroma. The dry hit leans fruity with hints of candy citrus, while the exhale brings out subtle grapefruit to round it out. This balanced hybrid delivers a flavorful, fruit-forward smoke that keeps things light and easy.
